node.title: Re^3: Mojolicious absolute url with query in template? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Oh, I think I see what you're getting at. Note the documentation for [mod://Mojolicious::Plugin::DefaultHelpers#url_with|url_with]:

Does the same as [mod://Mojolicious::Controller#url_for|"url_for"], but inherits query parameters from the current request.

Expanded url_for vs. url_with examples.

#!/usr/bin/env perl use Mojolicious::Lite -signatures; get '/' => sub ($c) { if ( !$c->param('foo') ) { $c->redirect_to( $c->url_for('index')->query(foo=>"bar") ) } else { $c->render('index') } } => 'index'; app->start; __DATA__ @@ index.html.ep % layout 'main', title => 'Hello, World!'; 
%=  url_for('/')
%=  url_for('/')->to_abs
%=  url_for('/')->to_abs->query(abc=>"xyz")
%= url_with('/')
%= url_with('/')->to_abs
%= url_with('/')->to_abs->query(abc=>"xyz")
@@ layouts/main.html.ep <%= title %>
<%= content %>

Visiting http://localhost:3000/ results in a single redirect (to add the query for demonstration purposes), and then renders as:

/ http://localhost:3000/ http://localhost:3000/?abc=xyz /?foo=bar http://localhost:3000/?foo=bar http://localhost:3000/?abc=xyz

Also, note the [mod://Mojolicious::Plugin::TagHelpers#link_to|link_to] helper: %= link_to Reload => url_with('/')->to_abs results in Reload
